gappers.catalyst: Neutron maiden flight delayed to 2027 (component rebuild for safety).
headlines: Rocket Lab (RKLB) Delays Neutron Maiden Flight To 2027 - Simply Wall St, Oct 16 2026
gappers.catalyst_detail: Rocket Lab postponed Neutron's first launch to 2027 due to manufacturing issues; a critical component will be rebuilt for safety. The delay pushes out medium-lift contract deliveries and extends R&D cash burn into 2027. Electron, satellite manufacturing and planned M&A are unaffected.
gappers.why: Slipped Neutron timeline defers larger launch and defense revenue and raises funding/dilution risk, so growth-multiple holders de-rate.
gappers.impact: Second consecutive day of Neutron-delay selling (-9.65% Oct 15, now -7.83% more); volume 1.14M is elevated, so it reads as repricing rather than a one-day spike. No sector read-through verified.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Gap-down, long-only bot: no long setup; a bounce entry would fail the Confluence rule. Max-6 positions and 3/wk caps are fully open (0 positions, 0/3 trades), so nothing is displaced, but a sane 7-10% stop on a falling knife makes 2:1 R:R unlikely. Research only.
